items.description: Point-to-point physical cable connection between two ports.

cable_id.description: Unique identifier for the cable connection.

cable_type.description: Standardized physical cable and connector assembly type.

color_hex.description: Hex color code for 2D/3D cable visualization.

from.description: Source or destination port endpoint of a physical cable.

face.description: Explicit rack face selector (used to distinguish front vs rear connections on passthrough couplers).

instance_id.description: Target device instance_id (top-level or child sub-module).

ip_cidr.description: Optional IPv4/IPv6 subnet or interface CIDR annotation (e.g. "10.10.20.0/24").

label.description: Optional cable label or circuit tag.

preferred_portal_u.description: Optional 1-indexed U hint for front-to-rear cable portal routing.

routing_mode.description: Optional routing strategy override: defaults to shortest-direct (shortest collision-free path); set to left-duct or right-duct only when the user explicitly requests routing via a side cable duct.

to.description: Source or destination port endpoint of a physical cable.

face.description: Explicit rack face selector (used to distinguish front vs rear connections on passthrough couplers).

instance_id.description: Target device instance_id (top-level or child sub-module).

vlan_id.description: Optional IEEE 802.1Q primary VLAN ID carried on this link (1..4094).

external_endpoints.description: External building/room cable drops (PoE cameras, Wi-Fi APs, room wall outlets) entering from the rear conduit onto a patch panel.

items.description: External building/house cable drop entering from outside the rack and terminating on the rear of a patch panel (consuming 0U of rack space).

category.description: Physical category of an external building or room drop entering the rack from outside.

color_hex.description: Hex color code for the external cable drop and its front patch guide.

endpoint_id.description: Unique project-wide identifier for the external building/room drop (e.g., "cam-01", "ap-eg-01", "room-office-pc").

entry_position.description: Rear building cable conduit entry point into the rack frame.

label.description: Human-readable label shown on cable badges and patching instructions (e.g., "Kamera 1 – Einfahrt", "Büro – Workstation").

patch_panel_instance_id.description: Target patch panel instance_id where the incoming building cable is punched down on the rear face.

patch_panel_port_id.description: Target port_id on the patch panel rear face (e.g., "p1" .. "p24").

poe_draw_watts.description: Required PoE power draw in watts (0 for non-PoE LAN drops; e.g., 9W for PoE camera, 18W for Wi-Fi 7 AP).

required_speed.description: Required Ethernet link speed for the external room/device drop.

room_or_zone.description: Optional building zone or room name (e.g., "Außenbereich", "EG Wohnzimmer", "OG Büro", "Heimkino").

vlan_id.description: Optional IEEE 802.1Q VLAN ID assigned to this room/device drop (1..4094).

items.description: Equipment mounted directly onto a rack unit.

children.description: Child sub-modules mounted inside this carrier.

items.description: Sub-module device mounted inside a specific slot of a parent carrier.

blueprint_slug.description: Hardware catalog blueprint slug for the child sub-module.

instance_id.description: Unique project-wide instance identifier for the child device.

slot_id.description: Target slot_id inside the parent modular carrier.

face.description: Mounting or port face relative to the rack or chassis.

instance_id.description: Unique project-wide instance identifier for the mounted equipment.

u_position.description: Lowest 1-indexed Rack Unit (U) occupied by this device.

project_name.description: Human-readable name of the rack layout project.

rack.description: Physical rack frame dimensions and enclosure configuration.

enclosure_type.description: Physical rack enclosure style governing front door clearance checks.

front_door_clearance_mm.description: Available clearance in front of Z=0 before hitting the front door in mm.

rail_depth_mm.description: Distance from front mounting rail face (Z=0) to rear mounting rail face in mm (max 2000mm).

rear_clearance_mm.description: Available clearance behind Z=rail_depth_mm in mm.

standard.description: EIA-310-D or homelab rack width standard.

u_height.description: Total vertical rack capacity in Rack Units (U / HE, 1..60).
